# picojson

`picojson.h` is unmodified picojson v1.3.0, downloaded from
https://github.com/kazuho/picojson/blob/v1.3.0/picojson.h.
Its BSD license and copyright notices are included at the top of the header.
It is compiled into the optional native staging extension; no runtime dependency
or Torch-independent Python extension is installed.
